title: review_event.v1
description: A review-loop event between the Builder and the Reviewer on the factory backbone (06_AgentZone/05_Review_Loop.md). review.requested (Builder -> Reviewer) references a review request object: the change to review, the spec it implements, and the previous round's findings. It is data for the Reviewer, never its prompt. review.completed (Reviewer -> Builder) references the round's review_findings.v1 document. Both carry a claim check (claim_check.v1); code itself is pinned by head_sha and read from the repository, never copied into the event.

event_id.description: Unique per event; the consumer's inbox key.

head_sha.description: The exact commit reviewed; a push to the PR is a new round.

round.description: PR review rounds end at round 4 (06_AgentZone/01_Agent_Standards.md §7).

blocking_findings.description: Only blocking findings (and deterministic DRY findings) start another round.

escalations.description: Labels that require a person (e.g. a protected-class lens finding). The Reviewer sets them; it never notifies people directly.
